scope: Read-only fail-before nonce boundary evidence and bounded repair design review; no source/build/test/engine/global writes.
verified: All five artifact hashes plus frozen source/test/review pins match. Actual named failure/direct1 retained; safe logs show canceled core, no premature reply, actual completion, identical request nonce/body, final reply deadline.
design: Same accepted request may wait for actual operation completion only when trusted mapper reports exact not_pending and private actual state proves entered, unfinished, canceled core with intact binding. Release all locks before select on operation.done/request.Done; map actual result under same original request context. Keep replay consumed at all times and publish at most once.
requiredGuards: pending currently checks cancellation BEFORE scope/profile/enrollment. New wait guard must independently verify actual server/owner/fullscope/profile/enrollment/heldlease, not rely on not_pending string alone.
Use bounded state gate and release before waiting; never hold owner.mu or operation.state.mu across completion wait. No detached waiter or new timer/request lifetime.
Operation completion race must use actual retained Session/error and fresh current enrollment/Docker/TLS observation. No cached state, retimestamp or receipt status promotion.
Authority/profile/lease/mapper/cancellation and concrete cleanup failures stay hard; only canceled entered pending core can gain this wait.
Expired original request produces no fabricated observation; nonce remains consumed even after ambiguous publish/flush or failed reply.
minimalControls: Exact existing genuine NATS canceled-before-completed same nonce returns correlated failed observation after repair.
Still-uncompleted canceled core reaches same request deadline and no reply; consumed replay state remains unchanged.
Canceled core with changed scope/enrollment or wrong owner/lease refuses wait despite initial not_pending.
Unentered/livecore/arbitrarymappererror/contextcanceled controls refuse wait immediately; completed race maps actual result only if originalctx remains valid.
Existing ambiguous Publish/Flush errors preserve consumed nonce and actual Run cleanup/error ancestry.
limits: 200ms receive interval is scheduling evidence rather than internal handler acceptance marker.
Direct private operation enter/complete are documented component seams, not production Bootstrap substitution.
